<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Remaining white cells: rows 39-42, cols 33-36 (10 cells)

    print(f"  {i}: '{row_str}' W={white_count}")

all_purple = all(ascii_lines[i][27:37].count('W') == 0 for i in range(34, 44))
print(f"All purple: {all_purple}")

if all_purple:
    # Block is solid purple! Now select white cursor and press SPACE to split
    print("\n=== BLOCK IS SOLID PURPLE ===")
    print("Next: select white cursor and press SPACE")
</parameter>
</function>
